references.text: Judas Iscariot goes to the chief priests to betray Jesus, which directly connects to his action mentioned in Matthew 10:4.
Lists the disciples and mentions Judas Iscariot as the one who betrayed Jesus, parallel to Matthew 10:4.
Includes Judas Iscariot in the list of disciples and identifies him as the betrayer, consistent with Matthew 10:4.
Jesus mentions that one of his disciples is a devil, referring to Judas Iscariot, which is consistent with the description in Matthew 10:4.
Peter speaks about the scripture that had to be fulfilled regarding Judas, who betrayed Jesus, which relates to his role as mentioned in Matthew 10:4.
